clips.title: The story
paras: Takrin Pathseeker sends promising adventurers from Durotar west to serve in the Barrens. His letter directs able-bodied volunteers to the border outpost run by Kargal Battlescar.

Takrin Pathseeker watches young warriors and scouts prove themselves around Razor Hill. He chooses those who seem strong enough for frontline service and gives them a letter for duty in the Barrens. Across the Southfury River bridge, recruits leave Durotar’s sheltered red dirt and join the Horde’s guard against quilboar, centaur, and Alliance scouts.

Kargal Battlescar receives the recruits at the outpost just across the river. The grizzled veteran manages the post and evaluates each conscript before signing off on their enlistment. A signed recruit is soon sent farther west to the Crossroads, where the frontier outposts are stretched thin.
